name: Dhruva (blank)
description: A buttery smooth, highly animated Dock for GNOME Shell. Personal fork of Dhruva, forked to be self-contained (own UUID, no dependency on the upstream repo/extensions.gnome.org still existing). Includes local theming tweaks: solid popup/context-menu background color, simplified window-thumbnail cards (no screenshot/title clutter), and a peek-effect gsettings gate.
